methodology.workload: Local fixture served inside each isolated worker. Static, canvas, DOM-scroll, and multi-page workloads use the same authored flow on both backends.
methodology.ordering: One excluded warmup run per backend, then alternating paired trials in fresh worker/browser/encoder process trees.
methodology.frameMetric: Canvas and DOM workloads encode monotonically increasing frame IDs into pixels; FFmpeg decodes them from source WebM. Static and multi-page workloads omit cadence scores.
methodology.scope: End-to-end recording from worker launch through media probing. Native uses CEF/I420/VP9; Playwright uses Chromium screencast MJPEG/VP9.
methodology.resourceMetric: 200 ms ps samples sum RSS and cumulative CPU across the worker and discovered descendants. CPU percent is sampled CPU seconds divided by total wall time and may exceed 100% across cores.
methodology.limitations: RSS can double-count shared pages, short-lived processes can escape sampling, and GPU memory and energy are not measured. Results describe this host and revision, not every website or platform.
